dct_description_sm: This project had for objectives: (1) for the Department of Community and Government Services (CGS) to work with communities and partners in defining key climate change issues, concerns, and impacts through climate change adaptation planning activities and to implement climate change adaptation planning into future municipal land use plans; (2) to collaborate with the Department of Environment and partners to address the issue of climate change at the territorial, regional, and community levels; and (3) to streamline the Government of Nunavut's planning processes to enhance decision-making related to identification, assessment and action on climate change.   Furthermore, this project was to help ensure coherence between climate change adaptation strategies and municipal land use plans in Nunavut by allowing CGS Planners to improve their capacities for adaptation. CGS Planners were to participate in 5 community visits to support climate change adaptation plans in Nunavut and, in doing so, accomplish the following objectives: (1) to help in introducing the final Community Adaptation Plans; (2) to contribute to the Canadian Institute of Planners' Climate Change Manual tool for assisting communities in their adaptation plans; and (3) to review/discuss the results of Community Adaptation Plans in Nunavut.
